Nil The Key Focus areas of R & D are always adherence to Green Chemistry principles and sustainability metrics, Process development and scale-up of new products, Process optimisation to improve yield, reduce effluent and cost, Custom formulation of gas treating and oilfield chemicals, Development of import substitutes aligned to strategic sectors, and Technology upgradation to meet international compliance norms.
